title: Consultancy Services for Construction of Bin Centre at Victoria Theatre and Victoria Concert Hall
what_it_is: Consultancy Services for Construction of Bin Centre at Victoria Theatre and Victoria Concert Hall

sections.label: Centralised refuse collection centre decision
sections.summary: A standalone bin centre for VTVCH was replaced by a centralised refuse collection centre serving VTVCH, ACM, Old Parliament House and Parliament House.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The original plan was to have a standalone bin centre for VTVCH.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: However, after extensive consultation with the planning authorities, it was decided that it would be better to have a centralised refuse collection centre that would serve not only VTVCH, but also the Asian Civilisations Museum (ACM), the Old Parliament House and the Parliament House.

sections.label: VTVCH consultancy cost benchmark
sections.summary: The total consultancy cost of the VTVCH redevelopment project, including the variation order, was 8.7% of total development costs, within the 10% industry benchmark.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The total consultancy cost of the VTVCH redevelopment project, including this variation order, was also assessed to be within the industry benchmark of 10%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: It was, in fact, 8.7% of total development costs.

sections.label: Consultant value engineering and AGO concern
sections.summary: Value engineering brought the final cost to $470,000, the project was assessed as delivered satisfactorily, and AGO did not conclude the consultant was overpaid but was concerned about the fee assessment process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The consultant also did extensive value engineering which brought the final cost down to $470,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Based on the work done by the consultant, we have assessed that the project was delivered satisfactorily and at acceptable cost.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: I should highlight that Auditor-General's Office (AGO) did not conclude that the consultant was overpaid, but was concerned about the process by which the consultancy fees were assessed.

sections.label: Fixed lump-sum contract preference
sections.summary: Hourly billing could have exposed the project to higher costs, so a fixed lump-sum contract would still be chosen if the project were done again.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: You could have gone by hourly wage, that means, you pay according to hours, billing by hours, but then you could be exposed to much higher cost in the end because it was a complex project, the consultants may take a lot more time and, in the end, you might have ended up paying a lot more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, overall, if we have to do this again, I would say we would still have gone for a fixed lump-sum contract, as was done in this case.

sections.label: AGO rule for construction projects
sections.summary: The AGO rule is a very reasonable rule for all construction projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the AGO rule, the rule is actually a very reasonable rule for all construction projects.

sections.label: Deviation from consultancy fee norm
sections.summary: A deviation from the consultancy fee norm based on construction cost was reasonable in this instance, and the issue was detailed documentation of the deviation, which the Ministry acknowledged.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In this instance, it would be reasonable to have a deviation from the rule of consultancy fee norm that is based on construction cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The issue, as I mentioned, was about having detailed documentation, about the deviation, and the Ministry has acknowledged this.
